classes.title: Beginner Indoor Walk
classes.description: A gentle 15-minute walk at home, led step by step. No equipment and no jumping. Go at your own pace.
classes.videoNote: MP4 not hosted yet (walk 96 MB, seated 46 MB; above Supabase free 50 MB/file for the walk). Recommend Bunny Stream.

timeline.name: Warm-up: Gentle March
timeline.modification: Keep your feet low, or hold a chair back for balance.

timeline.name: Warm-up: March + Arm Swings
timeline.modification: Keep the arms low if your shoulders feel stiff.

timeline.name: March on the Spot
timeline.modification: Slow it down any time, small steps still count.

timeline.name: Side Steps
timeline.modification: Make the steps smaller, or tap the foot out instead of stepping.

timeline.name: Knee Lifts
timeline.modification: Lift the knee only as high as feels comfortable, or hold a chair.

timeline.name: Step Touch
timeline.modification: Keep it slow and small.

timeline.name: March + Arm Swings
timeline.modification: Keep the arms at chest height.

timeline.name: March on the Spot (Round 2)
timeline.modification: Easy pace is fine.

timeline.name: Side Steps (Round 2)
timeline.modification: Small steps.

timeline.name: Step Touch (Round 2)
timeline.modification: Slow it right down if you need to.

timeline.name: Knee Lifts (Round 2)
timeline.modification: Marching is a great alternative.

classes.title: Seated Chair Workout
classes.description: A gentle 10-minute workout done fully seated. Great for low-energy days, joint pain or getting started.
classes.videoNote: MP4 not hosted yet (walk 96 MB, seated 46 MB; above Supabase free 50 MB/file for the walk). Recommend Bunny Stream.

timeline.name: Warm-up: Seated March
timeline.modification: Just lift the heels if lifting the foot is too much.

timeline.name: Warm-up: Arm Raises
timeline.modification: Raise to shoulder height only.

timeline.name: Seated March
timeline.modification: Slow it down and keep the arms still if you prefer.

timeline.name: Arm Raises
timeline.modification: One arm at a time.

timeline.name: Torso Twists
timeline.modification: Make the twist smaller. Skip if you have back pain.

timeline.name: Seated Leg Extensions
timeline.modification: Only straighten part way.

timeline.name: Seated March (Faster)
timeline.modification: Stay at your own pace.

timeline.name: Torso Twists (Round 2)
timeline.modification: Smaller twist.

timeline.name: Leg Extensions (Round 2)
timeline.modification: Part way is perfect.
